analytical_question: Where does internal-document RAG stand for requisition policy help, and what should the procurement team monitor over the next 90 days?
general_et_finding: As of 2026-11-16, retrieval-backed generation is commercially implemented for knowledge assistance. It can summarize linked material and surface source links. Accuracy and citation faithfulness remain deployment-dependent, and tested retrieval-backed tools can still hallucinate. Product capability, target-tenant readiness and credible performance evidence require separate checks.
application_finding: Position: suitable for a bounded read-only comparison. Curated policy search plus a staffed help desk is the strongest baseline for locating current policy and sending exceptions to an owner. A RAG assistant can synthesize answers across approved documents. Platform-native Joule is an adjacent option worth comparing only after feature and tenant checks. Compare all candidates on time to a correct, source-supported answer and correct escalation of exceptions.
organization_specific_finding: The leading signal is bilingual retrieval and citation quality on the current policy version, especially approval routing. With versioned documents and a moderate adoption posture, the manufacturer can evaluate a limited, reversible pilot. Confirm permissions, entitlement and incremental cost before involving Joule. SAP's Work Zone change is an ecosystem signal for a possible later transactional use, outside the read-only pilot.

evidence.claim: Atlassian documents generative answers over linked knowledge articles with source links.
evidence.notes: Illustrates deployment of knowledge assistance in the market.

evidence.claim: Tested retrieval-backed legal research assistants still produced hallucinations.
evidence.notes: Legal evaluation results do not quantify this procurement use case.

evidence.claim: NIST identifies confabulation and recommends contextual evaluation and monitoring.
SAP documents Ariba integration and possible extra entitlement and authorization requirements.
evidence.notes: Check the target tenant for bilingual policy support and actual entitlement.

evidence.claim: SAP identifies Build Work Zone as a prerequisite for Joule transactional capabilities in Ariba.
A field study reported a 15% average increase in issues resolved per hour across 5,172 customer-support agents with AI assistance.
evidence.notes: Directional evidence on potential time savings. Local gains remain unknown.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Stale or hype-sensitive claim: an Ariba installation includes Joule and guarantees it can answer bilingual internal policy questions. SAP documents integration conditions. Recheck tenant entitlement, authorized corpus coverage and bilingual citations in a sandbox with the tenant administrator.
Public evidence supplies no local price, accuracy, baseline completion time or measured ROI.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence in a reversible evaluation. Low confidence in procurement benefits or vendor choice pending local data. All numerical gates below are proposed management assumptions.
value_opportunity_implication: Measure median time to an independently scored correct answer against curated search plus the help desk. Also record reviewer time and licensing cost for a later value decision.
risk_governance_implication: Use only current authorized policy versions and link to the exact governing passage. Abstain on conflicts or missing authority. Procurement owns approvals and exceptions.
recommendation_management_implication: Within 90 days, run a paired read-only comparison on 60 matched tasks, 30 per language, mixing routine questions, exceptions and superseded policies. Score both options with policy owners and record unsupported answers and escalation errors.
change_monitoring_triggers: Procurement operations reviews paired results weekly. Advance to a limited pilot only if each language reaches at least 27 of 30 correct dispositions, median time to a correct answer is at least 20% faster than the baseline in each language, and the set contains zero critical approval-routing errors or unauthorized disclosures.
The policy owner checks on each policy release and suspends affected answers if the old version is still returned as current or any exception bypasses human review.

The Ariba tenant administrator checks monthly and on SAP entitlement or release changes. Add Joule to the comparison only after written entitlement and cost confirmation plus a sandbox demonstration of authorized bilingual citation and escalation.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Require representative test data, reviewer sign-off and permission checks before making any rollout claim.
Require actual license and support costs and a measured time baseline before estimating ROI.
